name: shadowlist-monorepo
description: ShadowList monorepo — native (Fabric) virtualization, list templates and example apps.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shadowlist-fabric/tsconfig.json && tsc -p templates/shadowlist-fabric-example/tsconfig.json && tsc -p templates/shadowlist-utils/tsconfig.json && tsc -p templates/shadowlist-macos-example/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -b templates/shadowlist-web-example
scripts.test: yarn workspace shadowlist run test && yarn workspace shadowlist-utils run test && yarn workspace shadowhash run test
scripts.test:core: cmake -S packages/shadowlist-core-tests -B packages/shadowlist-core-tests/build && cmake --build packages/shadowlist-core-tests/build && ctest --test-dir packages/shadowlist-core-tests/build --output-on-failure
